data.key: Unchained Ki Power ~ Wholeness of Body
data.name: Wholeness of Body
data.description: A monk with this ki power can heal his own wounds as a standard action. By spending 2 points from his ki pool, he can heal an amount of damage equal to 1d8 + his monk level.
